name: course-platform-caption-routing
purpose: Provider-neutral routing metadata for course creators preparing caller-owned subtitles for Thinkific, Teachable, Podia, or Kajabi.

thinkific.finalStep: Human uploads the reviewed caption file in the course Video Library.

teachable.finalStep: Human uploads the reviewed subtitle file to the course video.

podia.finalStep: Human uploads one reviewed VTT per language to the video.

kajabi.finalStep: Human reviews or downloads the subtitle file in the destination video workflow.

nextStep: Run the quality gate, retain the original, and let the account owner perform the final platform action.
